tagline: Trusted data. Visible analysis. Understand physiology.

modules.name: ECG Reference Lab
modules.summary: Trusted open ECG data made inspectable: raw versus filtered signal, baseline-relative morphology, time/amplitude calipers, annotations and reproducible provenance.

modules.name: OPL Visual HRV
modules.summary: Stepwise visualisation of RR/NN intervals, successive differences, time-domain HRV and Poincaré geometry using reproducible reference data.

modules.name: PPG & Pulse Transit Lab
modules.summary: Raw PPG morphology, pulse-foot timing, ECG-to-PPG arrival time and site-to-site pulse transit using trusted open recordings.

modules.name: OPL Cardiac Chart
modules.summary: Synchronised electrical and mechanical cardiac events using citable reference physiology.

modules.name: Vascular Pulse Lab
modules.summary: Central and peripheral pulse morphology and propagation concepts using synchronized open cardiovascular signals.

modules.name: Cerebral Doppler Lab
modules.summary: Visual teaching of cerebral flow-velocity waveforms, pulsatility and autoregulation using open reference data.

modules.name: OPL Recorder
modules.summary: Future live physiological acquisition feeding the same validated Reference Lab interfaces.

modules.name: OPL Calibration Bench
modules.summary: Future transparent calibration and signal-chain quality control for low-cost acquisition hardware.
